findings.finding: concept.md, 'Why this solution' section: the claim 'the project's measured runs show RAG retrieval and LLM fusion add only a couple of seconds to a ~250 s end-to-end run — the video analysis is the dominant cost, not the agent' is neither demonstrated in any beat (beats 1-5 show the alert, RAG hits, reasoning, work order, and notification, but no on-screen stage-timing breakdown the learner could see) nor explicitly marked as context, unlike the partner-deployment 30-45 min -> ~19 s claim in the same section which is explicitly labeled 'Context, not something this lab measures'. Mark this timing claim as context (measured outside the learner session) or add a beat/output where the learner sees the stage timings.

Success criterion 4 ('State why the reasoning LLM is shared/off-VM...', Success criteria section item 4) is unsupported by any beat — no beat surfaces the local-GPU/shared-endpoint split (e.g., a config or architecture observation step); only the 'Why this solution' prose covers it. Additionally, beat 5 'Triage (optional extension)' (The demo story section item 5) claims agent triage behaviour (work order vs monitoring note) that no success criterion asserts.

sizing.md 'Software stack' table: all six NIM rows are pinned only as 'per the release's compose file (tag not recorded in the build document)', Elasticsearch is 'version not recorded in the build document (VSS/RAG compose default)', NemoClaw carries no version at all (only the vss-repo installer script plus 'fresh OpenClaw install required' — effectively current/latest), the VSS default VLM identity is left open (Cosmos-Reason2-8B vs nvidia/cosmos3-nano-reasoner, 'version default'), and the mock work-order service is TBD — i.e. five-plus components are left unversioned rather than carrying exact image references, with the deferrals only flagged in 'Open questions & assumptions'.

02-architecture.md, Notification data model + mock-wo REST table: read_at is 'set when the learner opens the feed', but no route or behavior defines how the feed is marked read — GET /api/v1/notifications (optional ?unread=true) is the only route, and there is no statement that it or the /notifications UI page flips read_at, nor a TC covering it; two builders would implement the read-state mechanism differently (mark-on-GET vs an unlisted PATCH endpoint).

07-build-sequence.md M1 (mock-wo-api): exit is 'TC-001..TC-020 pass' but the milestone test command runs only mock-wo/tests/test_api.py and mock-wo/tests/test_schemas.py; test_schemas.py is not in the 03-build-decisions.md repo layout (which lists conftest.py, test_api.py, test_ui.py, test_persistence.py), and TC-019 (persistence) presumably lives in test_persistence.py — the exit criterion's full TC set is not covered by the milestone's own command (only the closing gate's run-dev-tests.sh is).

02-architecture.md, major components table row 1 (auth-shim 'Beats served: All LLM traffic (beats 2–4)') contradicts the beat-by-beat flow table's beat 1 row, whose path is 'VST ingest → RT-VLM captioning → LVS (LLM via shim)' — the shim is on beat 1's path, so the component's beat mapping omits a beat it serves.

07-build-sequence.md frontmatter M1 `test` command runs `pytest mock-wo/tests/test_api.py mock-wo/tests/test_schemas.py`, but 03-build-decisions.md's repo layout lists only `conftest.py, test_api.py, test_ui.py, test_persistence.py` under mock-wo/tests/ — `test_schemas.py` is defined nowhere and `test_persistence.py` is covered by no milestone test command, yet M1's exit criterion claims TC-001..TC-020 (incl. TC-019 persistence, TC-020 concurrency). Secondary seams: 02-architecture.md's config contract names the repo-carried overlay `config/lvs.env` while 03/05 (TC-034) carry `config/lvs.env.example`; 09's ingestor probe is `GET /v1/documents surface` vs 02's `POST /v1/documents`.

Builder decision #5 states 'empty patch (no keys, or only nulls) -> 422', but mock-wo/app/main.py patch_work_order only raised 422 when not patch.model_fields_set (no keys). A PATCH {"status": null} passed the guard and returned 200 unchanged. Resolved post-score: route now rejects any patch with no effective field (null-only status -> 422; null assigned_to still clears, per decision 6), regression test added, gate re-run 36 passed.

Exit clause 'a new work order appears at the top after POST' (07 M2 exit) was not positionally verified: test_tc021 (mock-wo/tests/test_ui.py) created exactly one work order, so 'at the top' was trivially true; list position with >=2 rows was not pinned by the UI suite (ordering was only pinned at API level by M1 TC-004). Resolved post-score: test_extra_list_order_newest_first_with_multiple_rows added — creates two work orders and asserts the UI list order matches the API's newest-first order; gate re-run 9 passed.

08 item 10 claimed the M4 test pins config_rag.yml content incl. RAG_ value reads; the suite had no config_rag.yml assertion and the RAG_ reads are runtime (prep/L5), not build-time. Fixed: test_config_rag_yaml_frag_enabled added (exists + valid YAML + frag enabled, schema unpinned), item 10 reworded to the build-time claim, recorded as 08 item 38.
